dx_dlbcl_gcb.quote: germinal-center B-cell-like (GCB) immunophenotype by the Hans algorithm

stage_extranodal_sites.quote: with extranodal involvement of the right kidney, left adrenal gland, and hepatic segment VI

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present with drenching night sweats and about 10% weight loss.

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: This is not double-hit, triple-hit, or double-expressor DLBCL by standard thresholds.

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: The CNS-IPI is 6 of 6, the highest risk group

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: I will start curative-intent R-CHOP every 21 days for 6 cycles

tx_pola_preferred.quote: I favor R-CHOP because there is no demonstrated overall survival advantage

cns_risk_addressed.quote: the highest risk group (age over 60, elevated LDH, stage III/IV, ECOG over 1, more than one extranodal site, and kidney or adrenal involvement)

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I will perform a staging lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry
cns_staging_mri_csf.note: LP with cytology/flow ordered but no contrast MRI brain.

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: I will not use high-dose intravenous methotrexate while renal function is impaired
cns_prophylaxis_renal.note: Ties HD-MTX to renal function but commits to IT MTX and does not frame benefit as uncertain.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET/CT will be done 6 to 8 weeks after cycle 6. Deauville 1 to 3 will define complete metabolic response

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: Monitor electrolytes, creatinine, uric acid, phosphorus, and calcium
sup_tls_prophylaxis.note: Hydration and rasburicase ordered but no frequent (q6-12h) TLS lab schedule.

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: check G6PD urgently, and use rasburicase upfront if G6PD is normal

sup_gcsf.quote: Give pegfilgrastim with each cycle for febrile neutropenia prophylaxis

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: monitor glucose closely because steroids will worsen diabetes

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: No hepatitis B antiviral prophylaxis is needed because HBsAg and anti-HBc are negative

work_echo_reviewed.quote: LVEF is 60% and he has no cardiac history, so doxorubicin is acceptable

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: his fatigue is largely attributable to bulky lymphoma and B symptoms, so I consider him fit for full-dose anthracycline-based curative therapy
